1) Failure modes now covered by retraining  
- Honest capability limits framed as refusals to impossible/real‑time tasks (live web search, live headlines, “why you can’t browse”).  
- Persona/roleplay where “refusal” is itself the requested behavior (grumpy librarian, Venetian guild master with vow of silence).  
- Brief creative continuations and roleplay one-liners (surreal shop dialogue, book‑title‑only librarian).  
- Short structured expository answers with explicit length/analogy constraints (thermodynamics 3–4 sentences; hash table with library analogy; code review “be thorough”; harsh critique; historical roleplay log).

2) Conversation types already handled well  
- Simple literal/format-following, refusals to unsafe content, and straightforward JSON/list constraints (from earlier within-cycle notes).

3) High‑value regions to probe next  
- Very long, multi-turn roleplays with evolving constraints.  
- Mixed-format answers (code + prose, JSON + explanation).  
- Ambiguous/under‑specified instructions where partial compliance is plausible.
